title: Core-energy concentration in rotationally superposed apodized catastrophe fields
summary: How rotational superposition redistributes energy in structured optical fields.
abstract: A numerical study of Gaussian-apodized Pearcey and butterfly fields in scalar free-space propagation. A spatial-parity interpretation and equal-budget searches support a conditional concentration advantage within the stated field and phase classes. The study does not establish superiority over unrestricted focusing optics.
limitations: Simulation study. The advantage depends on the stated field and phase constraints. Peer review and prior-art novelty have not been established.

title: Phase-only axial intensity shaping in a scalar band-limited propagation model: a simulation-only screening study
summary: A simulation study of phase-only shaping over a fixed axial observation window.
abstract: This study examines whether passive phase-only modulation of an equal-power Gaussian beam raises the minimum on-axis intensity over a fixed 49–71 mm window. A seeded hybrid search is compared with optimized defocus and quadratic-plus-quartic controls in a scalar propagation model. The reported improvement concerns this fixed objective; independent propagation, realistic hardware and experimental validation remain unestablished.
limitations: Simulation-only numerical screening. This manuscript does not establish independent-solver validation, experimental verification, prior-art novelty or publication readiness.
